title: A Brief History Of Everyone Who Ever Lived

questions.q: How does lesson 1 show that culture can change our genes?
a: Through the lactase mutation that lets adults digest milk
Through genes that make people taller
Through genes that change skin color overnight
questions.why: Lesson 1 uses lactase persistence as the example.

questions.q: Why did lactase persistence likely spread?
a: Drinking milk was an evolutionary advantage
questions.why: The summary says the mutation was likely advantageous for groups that drank milk.

questions.q: What does lesson 2 claim about royalty and your family tree?
a: Everyone is likely descended from royalty
Royal lines died out long ago
Royal ancestry can be traced to one king
questions.why: Lesson 2 says royalty is in the family tree of everyone.

questions.q: How long did it take to decipher the human genome?
questions.why: Lesson 3 says it took eight years to read the three billion letters.

questions.q: How much of our genes are actually readable, according to lesson 3?
questions.why: The summary says only two percent are 'readable'.
